name: Bodyguard
lore: You are a licensed bodyguard, standing by your charge ready to protect them from any threat.
skillProficiencies: Choose two from Athletics, Insight, Investigation, and Perception
toolProficiencies: Your choice of demolitions kit, disguise kit, or security kit
startingEquipment: A set of clandestine clothes, the kit for your chosen tool proficiency, a traumakit, and a belt pouch containing 75 cr

feature.name: Authorized Violence
feature.description: As a licensed professional, most law enforcement tend to turn a blind eye when you are involved in altercations. You are rarely detained due to wearing armor and wielding weaponry; in fact, while accompanying your client, it is typically socially acceptable for you to go both armed and armored.

suggestedCharacteristics: There are many reasons as to why you may be guarding someone. It could be that you and your family are in the service of a powerful individual, or that you owe a friend a life debt after they rescued you from some perilous encounter. You may be friends with the ones you protect: You may not. But in any case, your loyalties are unwavering, and your courage speaks for itself.

personalityTraitOptions.description: I am overly cautious of all food and drink that either my client or I consume.
I find it hard to leave my client to themselves.
I try to take the safest routes through cities, roads, or passes: I am not a fan of dark alley shortcuts.
If my client's legs were weary in a dangerous area, I would carry them every step of the way.
Even though I am constantly by my client's side, I cannot help but feel alone sometimes.
I often try to make situations sound better than they are to make my client feel more comfortable.
I may be a stick in the mud while I am sober, but I am wilder than a rancor when I am intoxicated.
I form attachments to those I care about, and often find myself going above and beyond to make them happy.

idealOptions.name: Guardian
idealOptions.description: I dedicate my life to defending those who cannot defend themselves (Light)

idealOptions.name: Indifferent
idealOptions.description: I do not have personal connections with my charge. They are merely part of the job. (Neutral)

idealOptions.name: Determined
idealOptions.description: I will protect those who I must... by any means necessary. (Chaotic)

idealOptions.name: Underhanded
idealOptions.description: I will learn my clients' weaknesses so that I may take advantage of them. (Dark)

idealOptions.name: Resolute
idealOptions.description: I follow the law laid down for me to protect those whom I am ordered to. (Lawful)

idealOptions.name: Flexible
idealOptions.description: I take into account my past experiences to help prepare for the future endeavors. (Any)

bondOptions.description: I have a home I love somewhere, though I rarely see it.
I am part of an order dedicated to protecting others.
The one who I look after saved me from something horrible once: I owe them everything.
I have other friends in this business who don't perform their duties exactly how I do.
While that time is behind me now, the faces from my past still linger.
My client isn't the only one who I should protect. There are many more out there without protection.

flawOptions.description: I have lost clients before. I now find myself detached to prevent future heartache.
I am often times forgetful, much to my client's dismay.
I am very stubborn. It is very nearly impossible to sway my opinions on how things should be handled.
Trust is a rare commodity in my line of work. As such, it is not something I often give to others.
My client and I don't get along in the slightest. It makes it quite difficult to want to look after them.
Although I am sworn to protect my client, I will abandon them in the face of certain death.
